'; fi; printf 'R109_MODEL='; if test -r /proc/device-tree/model; then tr '\000' '

'; fi; printf 'R109_IDMA_NODES
'; ls -l /dev/idma* 2>/dev/null; printf 'R109_MEMINFO
'; head -n 3 /proc/meminfo; printf 'R109_READONLY_IDENTITY_END
'
